Summary Results Report by Precinct' printed 'Precinct Summary - 03/05/2026 9:45 AM', Last-Modified Thu, 05 Mar 2026 22:43:28 GMT. 2026 runoff: only 'Unofficial Results Joint Primary Runoff Election Absentee, Early Voting and Election Day Summary' (county totals, 'Election Summary - 05/26/2026 8:44 PM', Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 02:33:59 GMT = 9:33 PM CDT) and an official results file; no unofficial runoff precinct report. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER (precinct reports printed and posted after election night, or none for the runoff), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence low because the 2024 and 2026 primary decisions rest on check 2 files posted after election night.
